messages:
Priya: Quick sync — final checklist for marketplace listing + Nimbus co-marketing. Need press embargo timing, blog publish window, landing page handoff, and SI/partner mentions approvals. Are we green for next Tue?
Alex: Can we push to Wed? Eng wants one more run on billing e2e.
Jorge: From Nimbus partner side they can do co-press but legal needs to ok the quote. They tentatively asked for Wed embargo 09:00 PT.
Mei: Product copy is done; I uploaded the draft to the doc and left TODOs for the Nimbus quote placeholder: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketplace-blog-draft (comments enabled).
Claire: Marketing can build the landing page but need hero assets + 2 screenshots and a short 40-60 word partner blurb by Mon 5pm PT.
Ben: For GCP/Azure marketplace listings we need SKUs, support contact, and a short support plan. I added a tab to the spreadsheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/marketplace-listing.
Priya: Proposed timeline (please review):
```
Mon: Nimbus PR quote due by 12:00 PT
Mon EOD: Marketing finalizes assets
Tue 10:30 PT: Eng signoff on billing + staging smoke
Tue EOB: Marketing submits marketplace listings (GCP / Azure)
Wed 09:00 PT: Embargo lifts / Press & Blog live
Wed 10:00 PT: Joint social + partner emails
```
Alex: Eng note: local billing tests passed. Full staging run scheduled tonight, will report by 10:30 PT. If any blocker, I'll call it out early.
Jorge: Nimbus legal wants to review PR quote text. I'll send them the draft and tag Nimbus-legal. Expect reply Mon morning.
Claire: One small ask: can we make the landing CTA "Start free trial" instead of "Contact sales"? PLG funnel preference.
Mei: I prefer trial too, but partner co-sell teams asked for a contact option. Suggest A/B on page, default to trial.
Ben: FYI GCP review usually takes ~48 hours. If we submit Tue EOB we should be ok for Wed publish, but any delay pushes us.
Priya: Ok decision: target Wed 09:00 PT embargo. Marketing submits listings Tue EOB. Claire to A/B CTAs (trial default). Nimbus to confirm PR quote Mon noon.
PressOps-Bot: Draft embargo copy uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/embargo-draft.txt. Suggested embargo: Wed 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC.
Claire: Added Asana tasks and assigned assets to @Mei and @Priya. Link: https://app.asana.com/0/marketplace-campaign
Alex: Will post status (GREEN/BLOCKER) by 10:30 PT tomorrow.
Jorge: Nimbus will review PR quote by Mon 12:00 PT and provide edits or approval.
Mei: Blog draft updated with Nimbus quote once they approve. Final proofread request to @PressOps-Bot when ready.
Priya: Quick checklist before submit: 1) Nimbus PR quote approved; 2) Eng signoff; 3) Assets in Figma; 4) Marketplace form fields filled; 5) PressOps final copy. Everyone confirm thumbs if on track.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Claire: :thumbsup: I’ll drop asset links in this thread once uploaded.
Ben: :thumbsup: I’ll finish SKUs and support contact by EOD.
Jorge: :thumbsup: will follow up with Nimbus legal.
Mei: :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks — final check in Tue standup and I'll ping Nimbus for any last-minute asks.
Jorge: Thanks all, will update here once Nimbus legal returns.
PressOps-Bot: Reminder scheduled: press embargo checklist due Tue 07:00 PT.
